litigation_timing.support: The amendment extended the saving of pre-1994 legislation in s. 10 from two to four years from the Basic Law's commencement. None of the searches identified a petition pending before the Supreme Court on 30.10.1996 whose outcome turned on s. 10 or on the validity of a pre-1994 statute under freedom of occupation; the explanatory notes (ה״ח 2549) were not reached.
litigation_timing.note: Not a response to a judgment. HCJ 3872/93 Mitral v. Prime Minister (22.10.1993) lies behind the 1994 re-enactment, not this amendment; HCJ 4676/94 Meatrael v. Knesset (PD 50(5) 15, 1996; date not verified here) concerned the override clause s. 8 and the Meat and Meat Products Law 1994, not the s. 10 saving of pre-1994 laws.

litigation_timing.source: Subject: Hebrew Wikisource חוק-יסוד: חופש העיסוק (s. 8 tagged תשנ״ח; s. 10 tagged תשנ״ז, תשנ״ח; current s. 10 text "עד יום א׳ בניסן התשס״ב (14 במרס 2002)"; publication line תשנ״ח, 178 = תיקון מס׳ 2); WIPO Lex text as summarised by WebSearch (amendment dated 19.3.1998, ס״ח 1662: s. 8(b) – the four-year expiry of an overriding law does not apply to a law passed within one year of the Basic Law's commencement); Globes report on Justice Minister Hanegbi's bill to amend s. 8 to that effect (globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=119491). litigation_timing.support: The amendment shielded the Meat and Meat Products Law 1994 (passed under the override clause within a year of the Basic Law) from the four-year lapse and extended the s. 10 saving to 14.3.2002. The only litigation surfaced is HCJ 4676/94 Meatrael, Tiv Taam and the Israeli Secular Movement v. litigation_timing.note: Not a response to a judgment; it followed HCJ 4676/94 Meatrael v. Knesset (1996, upholding the Meat Law under the override clause) and pre-empted the four-year lapse that judgment had left in place. Explanatory notes not reached.

deviations: Primary texts not reached: every fs.knesset.gov.il PDF on the sheet redirects (HTTP 303) to www.knesset.gov.il/maintenance-page-geo (geo-block); every web.archive.org link failed to connect (curl exit 000, WebFetch refused); nevo.co.il law_html and law_word links redirect to the Nevo login page; supremedecisions.court.gov.il unreachable; gov.il returns 403. Subjects therefore rest on Hebrew Wikisource consolidated texts (section tags and publication lines), the WIPO Lex consolidated Basic Law: The Knesset with per-amendment footnotes, Open Knesset copies of Constitution Committee protocols, Hebrew Wikipedia, and web-search summaries that read the Knesset PDFs for Amendments 27 and 36.
